Four selected owners retain twelve identity-bearing labels whose exact form or source-correction support was not established by the inspected merge/backfill history. This is a bounded evidence gap: the native policy admits these exact labels, but policy admission alone does not establish scientific equivalence.

Exact reviewed scope:
- Finding `CH-05`; stable key `w04-independent-CH-05`; immutable peer review `20261108T070033Z-w04-successor-science-v1`.
- `w04-chem-proposal-glutamate-monohydrate`; owner `data/ingredients/mapped/Sodium_Glutamate_Monohydrate.yaml`; before `1ba808e191b435067a404c3e1f7bdbb6371feba7d26b44a82e72bd66456004ca`; proposed SHA256 `5150e54eacd961dd7c5436659b72da736ed89a20ce86cf0f31d02aa48f212233`.

  [Exact published proposal](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9/reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-04/proposals/chemistry/Na2s2o3.after.yaml).

Review each listed literal against the original occurrence and authentic history. Preserve a damaged source label where MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3 and an exact source correction justify it; otherwise retain incompatible or unproved identity-bearing text as rejected provenance. A missing water qualifier, changed sodium/oxygen count and a source-proven spelling error require different reasoning. Do not delete all RAW_TEXT, silently normalize formulas, change owner identities, or release source holds by a blanket typo rule.

Deduplication: #1216 is a different owner (Na2moo4_X_2_H2o.yaml); #1191 is trisodium EDTA; #312 contains historical curation context. None supplies exact correction evidence for this four-owner set. Ignored-inclusive inspection of the review evidence is preserved in the sealed assessment; the fresh GitHub search is separately captured.

Review context: W04 published head `548e7bdd0ce2a68b3ae0df6ad7a6150a4e5c9bb9`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Main as observed at `0dac278466699129a083343a921c2e0ca18a9ab4` has the same eighteen affected inherited-owner blobs as the frozen baseline; this is not a report of already-applied campaign curation. The full independent assembly covers 188 source cases and 115 proposals and remains `needs_curation`. Original peer review and evidence are immutable. Agent-authored new mapping evidence must satisfy #1226 without relabeling historical human evidence. The fix must use existing native guarded proposal validation and independent re-review; it grants no maintained-owner or export approval and requires no new gate, threshold, or synonym-selection rule.
